questions.stem_text: Inefficient balancing or buckpassing by states can lead to what?

options.A: An increase in non-traditional security threats.
options.D: An increase in inter-state alliances and military restraint.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - A more competitive international system.

questions.stem_text:
What did Charles Krauthammer mean by a 'unipolar moment' when describing the post-Cold War
system?

options.A: The chance for the United States to share power with other countries in the world
options.B: An opportunity to use to collapse of the Soviet Union to extend US power
options.C: An international system that didn't face any threats
options.D: The never-ending domination of the United States

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - An opportunity to use to collapse of the Soviet Union to extend US power

questions.stem_text: Why did Lincoln oppose the southward expansion of the US?

options.A: It would have drained the US economically
options.B: It would have involved compromising opposition to slavery
options.C: It would have increased immigration to the US

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - It would have involved compromising opposition to slavery

questions.stem_text: Which of the following statements is the odd one out?

options.A: Societal groups have a right to survive.
options.B: Societal groups have their own reality.
options.C: Societal groups are constituted by social interaction.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Societal groups are constituted by social interaction.
